svg.title: Toy muTransfer alignment and mismatch
svg.desc: Two artificial convex loss curves: the narrow optimum is fixed at learning rate 0.20, while the wide optimum shifts continuously from 0.20 to 0.35. The selected narrow-model learning rate remains fixed. These are invented functions, not empirical tuning curves.
svg.text: Reuse a candidate, then validate it
Invented convex scores · no model training or empirical tuning
Illustration only: a fixed candidate may differ from the wide optimum.
